web_only.reason: the Radio rail is the page's chat column beside every view; in the terminal the chat is the program itself, so there is nothing to open
lists live and recorded sessions, prunes and deletes them; the terminal has `sleipnir sessions`, `sessions prune` and /sessions, each a command with its own output

lists every plugin by category with a switch, its state, what it adds and a form for its settings, and picks the profile; the terminal has `sleipnir plugins` (list, enable, disable, profile) and /plugins in the chat, which list and toggle the same plugins as text

eleven pages for the model, roles, budget, permissions, trust, run flags, tool servers, skills, providers and the configuration layers; the terminal has /model, /roles, /budget, /permissions, /trust, /mcp, /skills and `sleipnir config`

lists the project's research runs with their phases and evidence, opens a run's wiki in a browser tab, exports it and starts a run from a form; the terminal has /research and `sleipnir research`, which list, report, build and export the same runs as text, and the wiki opens from its index.html

lists the project's deep scans with their phases, shows a scan's findings with their traces, verdicts and reproductions, its attack surface and shard map, exports the report, reruns a scan and compares it with an earlier one (new, fixed and unchanged findings), and starts a scan of the project or of a repository it clones; the terminal has /scan and `sleipnir scan`, which list, report on, start, rerun and compare the same scans as text, and the report files are written beside the ledger

lists the agents' notes, every place an instruction file is read from with whether a session reads it, and the lessons, and edits them in place; the terminal reads and edits the same files in an editor (~/.sleipnir/MEMORY.md, ~/.sleipnir/SLEIPNIR.md, the project's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and SLEIPNIR.md), and the agents change their notes with the memory tool, each change put to the person
the catalogue of `sleipnir` commands with a form for each; the terminal types the command and reads `sleipnir --help`
probes an endpoint and shows each request; the terminal has the command `sleipnir doctor`, which prints the same steps
edits the cron jobs and runs the daemon; the terminal has `sleipnir schedule` and `sleipnir daemon`
the form that runs a `sleipnir` command from its flags and streams the output; the terminal types the command line
the tracker of files, changes, checkpoints and the merge queue of the session; the terminal has /rewind and /diff, which write their answer into the chat
the tree of the project with who owns each file; the terminal has no file tree (the agents' tools and /diff show files)
the changes by task or agent with a diff and a per-line gutter; the terminal has /diff, which prints one checkpoint's diff
the checkpoints with restore and its preview; the terminal has /rewind, which lists them and restores one
the merge queue, the verification of each task and the worktrees of an isolated team; the terminal shows the queue counts on the Board view and prints the integration at the end
